$comment: Design-query eval corpus. GROWN AND BALANCED 2026-09-15: 40 -> 122 tasks. The old corpus could measure 'is this model better overall' and could never measure 'better at WHAT' — McNemar needs six clean flips at any corpus size and that applies to every subset, so SORT=2, BOTTOM=2, LAYOUT=3 and TOP=4 were unmeasurable by construction. Every capability now carries at least twelve tasks. Three shipped tasks were REMOVED rather than edited because they filtered on members the fixture does not contain (there is no 'Europe' region and no 'Consumer' segment); the compiler checks names, not values, so they compiled and passed every gate while being unanswerable. Same-shape replacements over real members are in the filters batch.
